name: BUTYLHYOSCINE 20MG/1ML INJECTABLE SOLUTION 3 AMPOULES
description: Bumetanide, in a 1 mg, 20-tablet presentation, is a potent loop diuretic, also known as a “water pill,” used to treat excess fluid (edema) and high blood pressure. It works by helping the body eliminate excess sodium and water, especially when fluid retention is due to congestive heart failure, liver disease, or kidney disease. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
